name: hset2_half2_neg
desc: half2 boolean compare __heq2(__hneg2(x), y) -> HSET2.BF.EQ.AND Rd,-Ra,Rb,PT. Regression for the half2 REGISTER-operand negation bug on HSET2: lift_hset2 fetched ra/rb via the GENERIC _get_val, so -Ra was an i32 two's-complement negate of the packed f16x2 word (e.g. -0x38003800 -> lane0=-8.0 not -0.5) => wrong compare mask. Fix routes ra/rb through _get_val_half2 (per-lane fneg).
